$comment: Expiring test quarantine, checked by scripts/test-quarantine.ts (ompkit-v66l.27.2). A quarantined test still runs and is reported; only its failure stops failing push CI. Each entry needs test (<file>::<describe> > <name>), category, owner, bead, quarantined, expires (at most 14 days later), evidence (CI run ids), repro, reason and remove_when. An expired entry fails CI. Never quarantine a regression: an entry is for a test whose flake is observed on green SHAs and tracked by its bead.
